title: A busy Monday at work
content: Several deadlines arrived at once. I felt overwhelmed and kept switching between tasks. Writing down one small next step helped me finish the report.

title: Replaying a meeting
content: I stumbled over an answer in a work meeting and worried that my colleagues thought I was unprepared. Later a colleague thanked me for explaining the project clearly.

title: A walk and a conversation
content: I took a short walk after work and called a friend. I felt less isolated afterward. I would like to make more time for connecting with people.

title: A restless night
content: I stayed up scrolling on my phone and found it hard to sleep. I felt tired the next morning. Putting my phone away earlier is something I might try.

title: Making room for a hobby
content: I spent half an hour drawing instead of checking work messages. It was enjoyable even though the sketch was unfinished. I noticed that an activity does not need to be perfect to be worthwhile.
